answer_summary: Hello! As you are asking about filing your income tax return, please note that for companies, Form ITR-6 is the mandatory income tax return form for all domestic and foreign companies registered under the Companies Act, 2013, excluding companies claiming exemption under Section 11 for charitable or religious trusts. Filing must be completed electronically using a Class 3 Digital Signature Certificate (DSC) of the Managing Director or authorized Director. Upon submitting an Income Tax Return on the official e-filing portal, the system generates an Income Tax Return Verification form known as ITR-V containing a unique 15-digit numeric Acknowledgement Number, which acts as statutory proof of filing. Every unverified return must also be e-verified under revised Income Tax Department guidelines.

answer_summary: Hello! As an individual citizen taxpayer, you can file your Income Tax Return electronically through the official e-Filing portal. Please make sure to cross-verify your income and tax credits using Form 26AS and AIS, and choose the appropriate form such as Form ITR-1 (Sahaj) for salaried taxpayers or Form ITR-2 for capital gains, followed by instant e-verification via Aadhaar OTP or NetBanking.
